target.dimension: four-dimensional Minkowski target via a Euclidean construction if justified
target.axioms: Nontrivial gauge-invariant Wightman theory with positive energy, Poincare covariance, locality, vacuum cyclicity and specified unique invariant vacuum. An OS route must prove the required reconstruction hypotheses and target correspondence; not assumed established.
target.quantifiers: First selected G=SU(2). A result at this G alone does not discharge the official every-compact-simple-group target.
target.vacuum: Unique vacuum for the selected target; any changed vacuum-sector policy requires a successor.
target.domains: Nonnegative self-adjoint time-translation generator H and its closed physical quadratic-form domain after gauge/null quotient and vacuum subtraction.
target.units: hbar=c=1; declare an independently fixed reference scale mu>0 when comparing cutoff energies. No measured calibration or value of mu is supplied by the pilot.
target.gap: Exists Delta>0 such that q_H(psi)>=Delta*||(I-P_vac)psi||^2 for every physical form-domain vector.
target.source: Arthur Jaffe and Edward Witten, Quantum Yang-Mills Theory, official Clay description, https://www.claymath.org/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/yangmills.pdf
target.source_review: Official source identified from the prior microprogram; not freshly retrieved. Local indexed search returned unrelated sources and direct curl retrieval was tool-policy refused. No quotation or newly verified axiomatic-equivalence claim.

pilot.source: Four vertices in an oriented cycle with four SU(2) link variables, normalized product Haar measure and independent SU(2) vertex gauge actions.
pilot.holonomy: W=U0 U1 U2 U3, transforming by conjugation at vertex zero.
pilot.physical_space: L2(SU(2)^4)^SU(2)^4 is isometric to L2(SU(2))^Ad with normalized Haar measure. No finite spin cutoff in the written theorem.
pilot.basis: Orthonormal characters chi_n, n>=0, spin j=n/2; chi_0=1.
pilot.source_operator: H0=kappa*sum over four links of (-Delta_e), each link Casimir j(j+1); kappa>0 is a declared mathematical energy scale.
pilot.form_domain: Coefficient sequences with sum n(n+2)|a_n|^2 finite; operator domain uses the squared eigenvalue weight.
pilot.detector: Four-link left-invariant derivatives with ||D psi||^2=sum n(n+2)|a_n|^2; center-even-only readers are not faithful.
pilot.magnetic_term: H_lambda=H0+lambda*(1-Tr(W)/2), lambda>=0; bounded nonnegative multiplication with range [0,2lambda].
pilot.magnetic_gap_bound: After subtracting the actual ground energy: E1-E0>=3*kappa-lambda, sufficient when lambda<3*kappa. The actual vacuum is not chi_0 if lambda>0.
pilot.scale_control: For the explicitly declared convention kappa=g^2/(2a), lambda=2/(a*g^2), this sufficient condition is g^4>4/3. It fails along g->0; this does not prove the true gap closes.

claim_strength: Written all-character single-plaquette spectral theorem using imported compact-group harmonic analysis, plus exact rational gauge/matrix regressions; no proof-assistant closure or continuum theorem.
scope_gate: Constructed as a selected target definition and first bounded source test, not as an independent proof of official target equivalence. That remains required at reconstruction/assembly.
